  • tourism. [U] / [CO2]
  • Ans: Shopping tourism has become popular as tourists travel to buy unique and branded
  • products. Urban areas attract visitors with malls, markets, and luxury goods. Rural areas offer
  • handicrafts, traditional items, and local products. This type of tourism supports local artisans
  • and businesses. It also promotes cultural exchange between tourists and locals.

  • quick recovery.
